title: WaterColor "Vermillionaire" 46 Vermillion Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 16 wristbands- Wolf/Sub-Zero appliances: 2 dishwasher, 2 refrigerators, and ice machine - Complimentary Peloton Bike- Largest private pool in WaterColor at 18x46 feet *Pool heat is available for this property from October 1st - May 1st for $125 per day* Pool and sitting spa are heated together- Carriage house- 6 adult bikes- Shuffleboard, Ping Pong, Poolside Basketball Hoop, Star Wars Arcade Game, and more- 6 dedicated parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Enjoy an unforgettable escape at Vermillionaire, a stunning property comfortably accommodating 16 guests between the Main House and Carriage House, with 6 bedrooms and 7 bathrooms. Boasting a vast private pool, outdoor living space, game room—and access to WaterColor’s coveted Beach Club, this home’s the ultimate getaway!Rustic and coastal elements combine throughout the Main House, curating a comfortable environment for socializing. Curl up on the living space’s plush sofa, boasting 2 chaise lounges, and enjoy a family movie night on the 70” TV. A shuffleboard table adds fun. The kitchen’s premium appliances and center island are a chef’s dream. Entertain at the breakfast bar for 5 while preparing a delicious meal to share at the 12-seat dining table. Barn doors separate the light-filled library, fully furnished with a 55” TV. The backyard is a masterpiece of outdoor living, boasting an enormous pool, sitting spa, ping-pong table, cornhole, and poolside basketball. A covered patio with a sectional, dining for 8, TV, and grill ensures outdoor comfort and convenience. At night, unwind beside the inviting firepit. A guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom creates a peaceful retreat.Discover a twin daybed on the second floor, as well as the luxurious primary bedroom and 2 guest bedrooms, each with king beds and private bathrooms. A screened porch with a foosball table overlooks the pool, perfect for entertainment.Fun continues in the third-level game room, boasting a couch, TV, and 4 arcade machines, alongside a bunk room hosting 2 queen-over-queen beds.The sunlit Carriage House features a cozy living space with a queen sleeper sofa, a kitchen, and a guest bedroom with a king bed.Vermillionaire offers on-site parking for 6 vehicles, 6 complimentary bikes, and a seasonal trolley for exploration. Enjoy 2 beach access points via the Beach Club or Goldenrod Circle near the WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 16):FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom - handicap accessible Shower- Half Bathroom - Toilet onlySECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom - Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom - Shower Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom - Shower Only- Loft: Twin DaybedTHIRD FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Over Queen Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom - Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom - Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
